appearance.identity: Restored pale limestone drum, red-brown riveted iron bottle tower, two galleries and glazed lantern with copper-brown roof, attached east-southeast service wing.
appearance.epoch: First-stage restoration photograph and operator report May2024; later restoration is not asserted.
appearance.master: Retain original47546-triangle exterior, narrow ironwork and mapped wing plan.
appearance.browser: Four separate medium-fi levels, canonical limestone/ashlar/granite/painted-metal surfaces, local lantern glazing and no embedded reference images.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, fabrication/rivet-count accuracy, detached keeper buildings, surveyed island slopes and future restoration stages.
